text:
alessa: quick design check — pushed an update to the rules canvas. added a small contextual help panel that pins to the top as you scroll. need eyes on three things: contrast for rule chips, validation copy for empty/invalid rules, and how the preview simulation toggle behaves when rules are invalid. link: https://figma.com/file/xyz (mock) mike: :eyes: looks good overall. two quick nits: 1) the sticky header eats a lot of vertical space for long rule lists — can we make it condense on scroll? 2) rule chip contrast looks borderline at 14px (i ran an automated check). screenshot attached. sara: ran a contrast check — chip bg #F2F4F8 with text #1F2937 is ~3.9:1, fails 4.5:1 for 14px. we should either darken the text or increase bg contrast. also: validation messages need an aria-live so screen readers announce the state change when sim toggle fails. alessa: good catches. i'd rather not increase font size since density matters. what about darkening text to #0F1724? may be heavier visually but meets contrast. nate: product preference is to keep density too. i'd be fine with #0F1724. also behavior for preview: if there are invalid rules, instead of a modal, gray out preview and show a small inline banner: "Resolve rule issues to enable preview" and keep the sim toggle disabled. jo: i can implement the aria-live and overlay. suggestion for aria snippet: ```
Rule A: missing target
``` and CSS for focus ring: ``` .rule-item:focus { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: 2px; } ``` will also add aria-hidden on the preview region when overlay is active. mike: keyboard/navigation note — when focus moves to a rule we should ensure the pinned help panel doesn't cover it. maybe shift the help panel or auto-scroll focused item into view under the header. current mock hides the focus ring under the header. sara: copy tweak: please change "fix rule to preview" to "Resolve rule issues to enable preview" — a bit more descriptive and reads better with screen readers. avoid using "disabled" as a verb. alessa: love sara's wording. decision so far: chip text -> #0F1724 at 14px, add focus ring CSS, validation copy -> sara's suggestion, preview overlay + aria-live. jo — can you open a PR with the CSS changes, aria attributes, and a small visual regression test? include screenshots and i18n keys for the new copy. jo: yep, i'll open PR jo/rules-helpflow-contrast with unit tests and screenshots. will ping @deploy-bot to run visual-regressions once it's up. deploy-bot: visual-regression job queued for branch jo/rules-helpflow-contrast — i'll post results here when finished. nate: one last ask — can we add a tiny note in the component docs explaining the help panel behavior and the preview-disabled state so PMs and SRE know why preview might be turned off? i'll add a short blurb after the PR merges. alessa: perfect. i'll also add a design-token note to the component docs about the chip color and focus token. thanks all :thumbsup:
